svg.aria-label: Danish Roti: frontend engineer, tool builder, writer. Ship's log, day 1839: The radio gave us twenty minutes of static that sounded almost like rain. Drifted. Read a little. Wrote a sentence and crossed it out, which also counts. Out.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif

g.text: Woke to the hum of the recyclers and a sky that had not moved. Answered a hail from

g.text: mantrakp04/ardia. Signing off with the lights low.

g.text: The galley plants have started leaning toward the reading lamp. So have I. Spent the watch

g.text: below, mending things nobody will see. End of entry.
